scenarios.name: your-colorless-eldrazi-spell-reduced
scenarios.why: Thought-Knot Seer is colorless, so Ugin reduces its generic component by two. Its required colorless component remains, leaving {1}{C} to pay.

scenarios.name: your-colorless-noneldrazi-spell-also-reduced
scenarios.why: Ugin reduces every colorless spell you cast, not only Eldrazi spells. Bonesplitter's generic cost is reduced to zero and the artifact can be cast without mana.

scenarios.name: colored-spell-not-reduced
scenarios.why: Grizzly Bears is green, not colorless. Ugin does not reduce its cost, so {G} alone cannot pay its additional generic component.
